_comment: Example STATION CONFIGURATION with a profile library set and work states (`scan run`, the operator page /quick, the command bus). The configuration is what the station knows: its parameters and the profiles it can call on (long tube / short tube: each names the recipes that say what that tube looks like). It is NOT a work state: the work states are the steps of the flow (../flows/example_tube_line.json): a claim of the line's own sensor that the DLP confirms or corrects, and the permission it grants. Paths are relative to this file; $ENV_VARS expand. MOCK: `mock.cases` are the simulated line (the scene the simulated human places + what the simulated part-present sensor says).
description: Tube line: tube loaded? aligned? end face OK? - long and short tubes

part_present.description: the seat's part-present sensor (the line's own)
part_present.source: a PLC input: POST /api/io/inputs {"part_present": true}, or an input backend's `signals` map (stations/io_example.json)

long_tube.title: Long tube (60 mm)
long_tube.description: the 60 mm tube: its end face stands 62 mm above the seat plane

short_tube.title: Short tube (38 mm)
short_tube.description: the 38 mm tube: its end face stands 40 mm above the seat plane

all_good.description: a good tube on its seat; the sensor says present

sensor_true_part_absent.description: the sensor says present, the seat is empty: the DLP CORRECTS it

sensor_false_part_present.description: a tube on its seat, the sensor says absent: the DLP CORRECTS it

misaligned.description: the tube sits 3.4 mm off its seat: DEFECT at 'Tube aligned?'

dented.description: a 0.4 mm dent on the end face: DEFECT at 'End face OK?', kicked out
